acip: GNYIS PA NI, NGAR 'DZIN LHAN SKYES KYIS BZUNG BA LTAR GRUB PA'I BDAG DE CHOS CAN, PHUNG PO'I STENG DU MED DE, PHUNG PO'I STENG DU DE DANG GCIG DANG DU MA GANG RUNG DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: gnyis pa ni, ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis bzung ba ltar grub pa'i bdag de chos can, phung po'i steng du med de, phung po'i steng du de dang gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: Which brings us to our second point from above: a second way of looking at the subject under consideration here. Let's consider a “me” which could actually exist in the way that our automatic tendency to grasp to a “me” holds it to be. No such thing exists relative to the parts of me; Because it exists neither as one thing relative to these parts, nor as more than one thing relative to these parts.
